title: The ADHD Reading Cheat Code
target_audience: Students, neurodivergent readers, people struggling with attention spans

beats.name: The Scroll-Stop Hook
beats.inflection: [Intense Whisper / Shocked Eye Contact / Sudden Peak]
beats.text: If you have ADHD and can't finish books, stop scrolling.
beats.visual_action: Creator leans in close to lens, wide eyes, whispering intensely into microphone.

beats.name: The Setup & Entities
beats.tone: rapid-fire matter-of-fact delivery and fast tempo
beats.role: Introduce central struggle, relatable pain point, and immediate stakes
beats.text: I used to reread the exact same paragraph ten times in a row before giving up completely.
beats.visual_action: B-roll cut: Frustrated creator staring blankly at a dense book, facepalming.

beats.name: The Dramatic Twist
beats.tone: incredulous and shocked with building excitement
beats.role: The bizarre turning point, unexpected solution, and demo
beats.text: Then I imported my entire textbook into VoiceReader, turned on the hyper-realistic narrator at two-times speed, and finished three full chapters while doing my laundry without losing focus once.
beats.visual_action: Phone screen recording showing VoiceReader app: animated karaoke highlight running at 2x speed while creator folds clothes with AirPods in.

beats.name: The Moral Dilemma & Question
beats.tone: amused deadpan and engaging rising intonation
beats.role: Viral Engagement Engine: prompt debate in comments
beats.text: Is this a genius productivity hack, or does listening count as actual cheating?
beats.visual_action: Creator cuts back to front camera, raising an eyebrow with an amused, questioning grin.
